Lightbox.review_note: Replaces the upstream pattern removed by the Lightbox correction: the file must be named exactly lightbox.js, lightbox.min.js or lightbox-plus-jquery(.min).js (Lightbox2's own file names), right after a slash. Matches shapirolawfirm.com (lightbox.min.js?ver=2.7.1 with lightbox.css?ver=2.7.1: 2.7.1 is a Lightbox2 version) and bfnelson.it (Breakdance's dependencies-files/.../lightbox.js: not sure it is Lightbox2). Accepted by the human reviewer on 2026-11-21 after the preview on all 200 domains.

Onsen UI.review_note: Replaces the upstream pattern removed by the Onsen UI correction: Onsen UI's own file names (onsenui.js, onsenui.min.js, angular-onsenui.js). Matches none of the 200 domains; kept so the product can still be found elsewhere. Accepted by the human reviewer on 2026-11-21 after the preview on all 200 domains.

Bandzoogle.review_note: A hosted website builder for musicians, missing from the rules. On davidloeppke.com: every script and stylesheet from assets-openresty-kamal-production.bndzgl.com/assets/usersite..., images from images.zoogletools.com/s:bzglfiles/..., stats from stats.zoogletools.net, name servers dns1/dns2.sitezoogle.com. The vendor's ownership of bndzgl.com was not checked on its website (source_verified false). Needed so the builder's servers (OpenResty, Varnish, Let's Encrypt) and Ruby on Rails move to platform_infra. Accepted by the human reviewer on 2026-11-21 after the preview on all 200 domains.
